def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    Z0 = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]])
    def fit(cols):
        A = np.column_stack([Z0] + [X[:, j] if not isinstance(j, tuple) else X[:, j[0]] * X[:, j[1]] for j in cols])
        b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30)))
            w = np.maximum(mu * (1 - mu), 1e-9)
            step = np.linalg.solve(A.T @ (A * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1]), A.T @ (y - mu))
            b += step
            if np.abs(step).max() < 1e-7: break
        mu = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(mu) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - mu))), mu
    R = np.corrcoef(X.T); R = np.nan_to_num(R)
    def pv(ll1, ll0, df=1): return stats.chi2.sf(2 * max(ll1 - ll0, 0), df)
    sel = []; base, _ = fit(sel)
    gates = [0.25 / p, 0.05 / p, 0.02 / p]
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        cand = [j for j in range(p) if all(abs(R[j, k]) < 0.6 for k in sel)]
        if not cand: break
        lls = {j: fit(sel + [j])[0] for j in cand}
        j = max(lls, key=lls.get)
        if pv(lls[j], base) >= gates[min(len(sel), 2)]: break
        clus = [k for k in cand if abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6 and lls[k] >= lls[j] - 3.0]
        j = max(clus, key=lambda k: np.sum(np.abs(R[k, [m for m in cand if abs(R[j, m]) >= 0.6]])))
        sel.append(j); base = lls[j]
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        full, _ = fit(sel)
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [k for k in sel if k != j]
            if pv(full, fit(rest)[0]) >= 0.01 / p:
                sel = rest; changed = True; break
    full, mu = fit(sel)
    r = y - mu
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    P = np.stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs], 1)
    P = P - P.mean(0)
    sc = (P.T @ r) ** 2 / np.maximum((P ** 2).T @ (mu * (1 - mu)), 1e-9)
    top = [pairs[i] for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]]
    npairs = p * (p + 1) / 2
    res = []
    for a, b in top:
        mains = sorted(set(sel) | {a, b})
        l0 = fit(mains)[0]; l1 = fit(mains + [(a, b)])[0]
        q = pv(l1, l0)
        if q < 0.01 / npairs: res.append((q, a, b))
    res.sort(); prods = []; used = set()
    for q, a, b in res:
        if len(prods) < 2 and not ({a, b} & used):
            prods.append((a, b)); used |= {a, b}
    if prods:
        keep = []
        allm = sorted(set(sel) | used)
        terms = allm + prods
        lf = fit(terms)[0]
        for j in sel:
            if j in used or pv(lf, fit([t for t in terms if t != j])[0]) < 0.01 / p: keep.append(j)
        sel = keep
    drivers = list(sel)
    for a, b in prods:
        for k in (a, b):
            if k not in drivers: drivers.append(k)
    drivers = drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    cols = sorted(set(sel) | {k for a, b in prods for k in (a, b)})
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
